summary: The pi channel heartbeat test hangs up once a heartbeat has re-stamped the record, instead of after a fixed 40 ms sleep: on a loaded host the loop could first run after the sleep, see EOF and return before any heartbeat was due, so the test failed its first try.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.
